thread:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER DUTY ALERT ‹sev2› — ingress-azb (edge) reporting >30% 5xx across multiple services in eu-west. Auto-paged on-call.

alex: seeing influx of `connection reset by peer` and Envoy 502/504 spikes. Graphs show sudden jump at 12:03 UTC.

mira: confirmed — Envoy upstream 502/504 and ALB target group health shows many targets flapping UNHEALTHY. Logs show repeated `RST_STREAM` and `HTTP/1.1 502` from upstream.

jim_oncall: I'm on it. starting triage. any recent deploys? paging handoff to netops after initial triage.

deploy-bot: deploy: service/ingress-config v2.8.1 rolled 11:58 UTC by ci/cd (commit 9f3b2d). No other app deploys in last 30m.

anne_sre: note — that config change adjusted `envoy_idle_timeout` from 60s -> 20s as part of connection hygiene. Could cause race with ALB keepalives for long-lived clients.

sam_netops: checking LB plane. ALB shows partial spike in target health in AZ-b only, NLB connection counts look normal. Route53 checks: weighted policy for eu-west has two records (azb/azc). Both are healthy per health-check, but I see increased latency to azb routers and some AS path changes from our peering provider at 12:02.

alex: stacktrace snippet and envoy error lines pasted:
```
[2026-03-15T12:03:05Z] envoy error: stream reset: rx_reset
[2026-03-15T12:03:06Z] upstream 10.2.14.87:502 connection reset by peer
```

mira: rolling logs for ALB show `target deregistration` events? Investigating if health check responses are timing out under new idle timeout.

jim_oncall: customer-impact check — dashboards show ~18% of production requests returning 5xx for some customers in eu-west, most notably tenant: fintech-payments and shopify-mapper. Impact: degraded transaction flow and retries. Not a full outage but user-visible errors.

lee_cs: pinged CS channel and provisional customer message drafted — "We are investigating increased errors in EU-West affecting some API requests; we will share updates every 15 minutes."

anne_sre: mitigation options: (1) rollback ingress-config change (fast), (2) adjust ALB health-check/keepalive thresholds (risky across fleet), (3) shift traffic weight off AZ-b via Route53 weighted policy (fast, partial mitigation). Prefer (1) + (3) in parallel.

sam_netops: I can push a traffic-shift to azc to reduce azb weight to 10% (current 50/50) — will respect failover playbook. Setting Route53 TTL to 30s for faster convergence.

alex: preparing rollback PR to revert idle timeout change. Patch ready, need approval to apply as emergency rollback. Diff:
```
- envoy_idle_timeout: 20s
+ envoy_idle_timeout: 60s
```

jim_oncall: I'll approve and kick rollback once netops confirms traffic shift started. Coordinate with deploy-bot so CI gating bypass for emergency.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: ingress-config revert -> env rollout. ETA ~4m once approved.

sam_netops: starting weighted DNS update now. command: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://shift-azb-to-azc.json`

sam_netops: CHANGEID: /change/ABC123 — request submitted. TTL lowered. Expecting gradual shift over next 60-120s. Monitoring health.

(1m) miro: health check flaps decreasing but still noisy. 5xx rate dropped from 30% -> 12% after initial weight shift.

anne_sre: proceed with rollback. apply with `kubectl apply -f ingress-config-revert.yaml` and monitor. Keep one instance steady for canary.

alex: rollback applied at 12:08 UTC. Envoy pods are rolling, new pods have idle_timeout=60s.

deploy-bot: rollout status: 3/3 ingress nodes updated, 1 error transient, now healthy.

jim_oncall: monitoring metrics — 5xx now at ~3-5% cluster-wide, azb specifically trending down. Customer-facing errors reduced.

sam_netops: Route53 shift complete and change propagated. azb traffic now ~12%, azc ~88%. No signs of route blackhole.

mira: ALB target health stabilized. No further rapid deregisters. Envoy logs show fewer resets.

lee_cs: posted update to customers: "Issue mitigated — traffic shifted away from impacted edge and configuration rollback applied. We will continue to monitor and follow up with RCA." :thumbsup:

anne_sre: next steps for RCA: capture packet traces for azb-peers during 12:00-12:10, correlate peering provider BGP/maintenance events, and validate keepalive/idle-timeout interactions across ALB->Envoy->upstream.

jim_oncall: assigning follow-ups — sam_netops will pull peering telemetry, mira will gather envoy/ALB trace logs and logs around target deregistration, alex will draft incident timeline and mitigation notes. I'll open a jira: INC-37213-RCA. Handoff to on-call shift in 30m for post-incident monitoring.

sam_netops: quick note — peering provider acknowledged packet loss at 12:01-12:04 due to maintenance flap, they claim limited reachability to azb. Will share provider incident link.

alex: thanks everyone. final status: mitigated (partial rollback + DNS shift). No broader regions impacted. Monitoring until T+60.

pagerduty-bot: Incident 37213 status updated -> acknowledged -> mitigated. Pager duty log: acknowledged by jim_oncall at 12:10 UTC.

jim_oncall: handing off to anne_sre for overnight monitoring and RCA ownership. If anything resurfaces escalate to ENG-SRE.

anne_sre: taking handoff. I'll run a 2h watch with alert thresholds lowered for eu-west. Adding `escalation:eng-sre` if error rate >7% for 5m.

(end of thread)
